facts.fact: FHI 360's EpiC Lesotho request for proposal seeks a consultant, July to September 2026, to coordinate integration and interoperability of its LEAD, Infolink and DHIS2 Tracker systems with the national DHIS2 platform and partner platforms, and to create import files from Tracker DHIS2 systems for aggregate systems.
facts.system: Integration of LEAD, Infolink and DHIS2 Tracker with the national DHIS2 platform

note: The as_of is the document's published date; the document gives no start date for the integration work beyond the consultancy window (the posting is a solicitation, not an award).

facts.fact: WHO's 2025 Lesotho report says the country advanced interoperability across HMIS, HRH, LMIS and surveillance platforms in 2025, and lists institutionalizing interoperability of digital systems as a continuing challenge.
facts.system: Interoperability across HMIS, HRH, LMIS and surveillance platforms

systems.system: DORIS (Digital Online Reporting and Information System)

note: Capture is truncated near its end; the National Digital Health Strategy 2025-2030 endorsement is a policy, so no fact is recorded for it.

facts.fact: The BMJ Open study says the eRegister, piloted in 2018, is configured to compile and send facility-level data automatically into the district health information management system, and that three pilot facilities were using it when interviewed.
facts.system: eRegister to district health information management system data flow

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with implementing partners (ICAP funds it)
systems.tiers: four health centres and two hospitals piloted; 178 government facilities planned

note: The as_of is the start of the interview period, December 2023 to March 2024; the configuration statement itself cites a 2022 source.

facts.fact: The study states that the Ministry of Health's eRegister (EMR) is integrated with the national DHIS2, which facilitated more robust data collection and analysis, and that the eRegister has been in use since 2018; the document gives no date for the integration, so its published date is used.

systems.platform: open-source client-level electronic register for HIV, TB and MCH services
